$comment: KRYLO's Codex hook set (docs/adr/0029-codex-host-packaging-and-approval-boundary.md). Unlike Claude (ADR-0021, hooks scoped to the run Skill's own frontmatter), Codex plugin-bundled hooks have no Skill-scoped lifecycle and fire for every ordinary Codex session -- every entrypoint below implements the inactive-run no-op path (resolve identity, check for an active KRYLO run, exit 0 with no output and no state mutation if none) so a session that never invokes $krylo-run pays only the measured no-op latency budget. Referenced explicitly via .codex-plugin/plugin.json's own "hooks" field, not auto-discovered, so this never collides with Claude's separate (deliberately empty) hooks/hooks.json. PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hold the actual security boundary (scripts/security/risk-gate-codex.mjs, scripts/security/permission-request-codex.mjs); PostToolUse is telemetry-only and is never a security boundary.
